svg.title: Public documents: a starting point in at least 86 countries
svg.desc: All 197 countries screened at national level. 86 have detailed operational material, 41 promising but unresolved, 20 public-facing evidence only, 50 unknown. Publication evidence is not validated mapping accuracy. Small states shown as dots.

g.text: Public documents: a starting point in at least 86 countries
197 countries searched · selected sources verified · research conducted 31 October 2026

path.title: French Southern and Antarctic Lands: outside study registry
Central African Republic: Detailed operational material
Trinidad and Tobago: Public-facing evidence only

circle.title: Antigua and Barbuda: Public-facing evidence only
Saint Vincent and the Grenadines: Public-facing evidence only
São Tomé and Príncipe: Detailed operational material

g.text: Of the 86: 46 have public-facing or regulatory workflows; 40 qualify through government operations.
Publication evidence, including historical manuals—not complete maps, current readiness or paying customers.
Unknown does not mean unsuitable. National level only. Small states shown as dots; other territories unclassified.
Source: Fulcrum 197-country screening and reviewed evidence · Boundaries/label points: Natural Earth (public domain)
